column1: # The defect floor: grid rows this stand is REQUIRED to call defective.
# It checks the classifier, not completeness. A ledger written to a known list
# of defects passes that list and stays tautological outside it — that is said
# in `01-promise.md` and is not softened here.
# The 21 rows outside `rules:` come from `measurement/non-rules-roots.tsv`, and
# they are an INPUT, not evidence: that artifact was measured with the broken
# `--no-cache`, so the floor is RE-TAKEN here under the isolation protocol of
# 02 §4. A disagreement with the old count is a fact for the report, never a
# `verdict` names the one expected where the round can name it; `any-defect`
# means the floor requires a defect without fixing which of the seven.
# A `pair` row is addressed by `pair|<rule>|<a>|<b>|<scope>|<kind>`. The kind
# is the last segment because nineteen `same-source` pairs are a ledger row
# twice under two kinds; without it this floor row would address one of two
# cells and no one could say which.
